scope: PASS3D ordinary child sword/shield, idle/move/turn/target, static floor/wall, NORMAL/TARGET/FOLLOWTARGET/STILL camera

pass4b_adapters.motion_velocity: PlayerMotionCore AdvancePlayerMotion: legacy velocity units, displacement gain q/4; root deltas excluded; bounded idle/slash/movement/wall fixtures qualified; general movement remains excluded.
pass4b_adapters.gravity: Constant-force affine continuation from TIMING_SEMANTICS; terminal hold supported, clamp crossing rejected before commit. Static grounded admission must preflight the segment.
pass4b_adapters.collision_correction: Already-integrated world OC displacement applies only at a shared boundary; Player static query correction remains geometric.
pass4b_adapters.yaw_smoothers: Bounded field owners: signed sixths residue, shortest-angle wrap, snap/reset and external assignment detection. Piecewise/exponential choices are integrated but bounded movement/targeting engine coverage passes; general cap/snap equivalence remains Class 3.
pass4b_adapters.combo_window: Six-quanta pulse reset on authored unk_844=8; signed B-release latch retained, zero/combo-clear opportunity retained.
pass4b_adapters.combo_mixed: Attack ordinal remains immediate; >=3 late-pose extension has its own six-quanta opportunity, initially immediate on attack entry.
pass4b_adapters.blur: History/geometry evaluated per Player pose; blur sample ingress separately limited to a six-quanta opportunity. Effect lifetime remains world20.
pass4b_adapters.world_ancillary: Ownership gates retain blink/face RNG, interface, sequence audio, ambient floor settings, rumble, targetPriority and stick hook/history at world cadence; eight representative world boundaries remain exactly once per transaction in the high-rate and QA receipts.

canonical_rule: All original expressions, casts, clamps, resets and call ordering remain untouched at Hz20. Hz20 metadata remains observational; high-rate contexts select only admitted owned adapters.
rate_owner_rule: Each future conversion has exactly one owning layer. Callers must not rescale an already integrated displacement or event.
